title: 1:1 prep — Sasha Patel (eng report)
content:
Meeting: 1:1 with Jordan (manager) — Tuesday 2026-02-21, 10:30am PT
Duration: 30m
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle
Purpose: weekly sync — surface blockers, align on priorities for next sprint, career check-in items, and action items follow-up.

Agenda:
- Quick status (3–5m): what shipped, what didn't, metrics to call out
- Blockers (7–10m): infra / infra-sre handoff, CI flakiness, dataset availability
- Priorities & scope (7–8m): reprioritization request for low-latency KV cache work vs quantization test matrix
- Career / feedback (5m): progress on leadership goals, expectations for next quarter
- Action items + next steps (3–5m)

Notes / Talking points I want to cover:
- Wins since last 1:1:
  - Reduced p95 latency on v2 routing by ~12% after kernel switch; benchmark summary attached to PR (see linked PR).
  - Closed two customer-impacting tickets in last sprint (ENG-3389, ENG-3412) — shortened fallback path by moving TTL out of hot cache.
  - Mentored Priya on perf debugging flow; she ran a successful repro and is now tracking a follow-up refactor.

- Current top priorities (what I intend to push this sprint):
  1) KV cache stability & observability (owner: Sasha) — shipping improved cache eviction metrics, rollout plan to 10% canary by EOW.
  2) Low-latency kernel selection automation (owner: Jordan + eng infra) — prototype done, need decision on rollout strategy.
  3) Quantization test matrix for customer A (owner: Priya) — blocked by dataset access.

- Blockers / escalations (need Jordan's help):
  - Dataset access: still waiting on legal/PS to approve data transfer for quantization tests. Ask Jordan to ping Solutions Eng / Legal.
  - CI flakiness: nightly perf CI has 2–3 failing tests due to GPU memory nondeterminism; need SRE time to debug. Request 2 dedicated SRE days this sprint.
  - Capacity for Dedicated rollout: capacity planning spreadsheet shows we may exceed reserve in region eu-central-1 if we enable burst for the Canary customers. Need to confirm autoscale safety nets.

- Metrics to surface:
  - p50/p95 token latency (v2 routing) baseline: p50 28ms, p95 130ms -> after change p95 114ms.
  - Cache hit rate: 72% (goal 80% by EOW)
  - CI pass rate (nightly): 87% last week (target 95%)
  - Customer-facing errors: 0.03% of requests vs target 0.01%

- Career / growth conversation notes:
  - Progress on "Influence without authority" goal: ran cross-team perf review, fewer surprises in rollout notes; ask Jordan for feedback on how to increase visibility to product leadership.
  - Interest in stepping into IC3 lead role next quarter — ask what concrete signals Jordan wants to see (scope of projects, mentorship, docs).

Action items from last 1:1 and status:
- Sasha: follow up with Legal on dataset MOU — STATUS: emailed 2026-02-18, waiting reply.
- Jordan: escalate SRE allocation for perf CI — STATUS: Jordan indicated OK, waiting schedule.
- Priya: draft quantization test plan — STATUS: blocked (dataset).

Proposed action items coming out of this 1:1 (assign owners + tentative due dates):
- Sasha: escalate dataset MOU with a one-pager summarizing risk + controls; cc Legal + Solutions Eng — due 2026-02-24.
- Jordan: if possible, allocate 2 SRE days this sprint to investigate CI nondeterminism; confirm by 2026-02-23.
- Sasha & Priya: prepare minimal synthetic dataset to unblock quantization tests (short-term workaround) — due 2026-02-26.
- Jordan: review and sign-off on canary autoscale safety net doc (link above) — due 2026-02-25.
- Sasha: update onboarding doc for perf debugging (add checklist) and assign to eng-new-hires repo — due 2026-03-01.

Follow-ups I want from Jordan this week:
- Quick intro to Legal contact (name/email) who can triage MOU faster.
- Decision on SRE allocation or alternative (maybe pairing with infra engineer).
- Feedback on visibility tactics for career request (who to loop in, suggested stakeholders).

Other notes / context to keep on hand:
- Related tickets: ENG-3412 (fallback path), ENG-3389 (cache TTL), ENG-3421 (perf regression triage).
- Customer A: quantization trial — primary contact is Alex Kim (Solutions Eng).
- Mini-PR to reference during meeting: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/418

Personal prep checklist (what I'll bring to the meeting):
- Short TL;DR on wins (1 slide or 2 bullets in chat)
- One-pager MOU summary (draft)
- Perf numbers snippet (copy from Datadog)
- List of 3 asks (Legal intro, SRE allocation, canary sign-off)

Post-meeting follow-ups I will do immediately:
- Send summary DM in Slack to Jordan + Priya with action items and owners
- Create Jira ticket for synthetic dataset work and link to PR
- Update this doc with final action items and new due dates

Questions to self to reflect on during 1:1:
- Am I delegating enough? What tasks can I hand over to Priya to accelerate my focus on infra priorities?
- What blockers keep recurring and are avoidable by better runbooks?
- How to measure "influence" progress quantitatively (e.g., number of cross-team approvals without escalations)?

End of notes.

-- Sasha
